units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:9">B. Mets. VII, 9</cite> <he>ז׳ אחד וכ׳</he> the attack by one wolf is not considered an accident relieving from responsibility; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְאֵבִים</he>, <he>זְאֵיבִים</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:9">Ib.</cite> <he>בשעת משלחת ז׳</he> at a time when wolves are coming forth in hordes, v. <cite ref="M02915"><he>מִשְׁלַחַת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:2:9">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ</cite> top; Y. Ter. XI, end, 48ᵇ.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:11">Esth. R. to IX, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00088"><he>כִּבְשָׂה</he></cite>; a. fr.—Fem. <he>זְאֵבָה</he>.

X, 13</cite> <he>נזדמנה הז׳ וכ׳</he> a she-wolf was provided for them who gave them suck; v. <cite ref="T00385"><he>רוֹמוֹס</he></cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:14">ib. to XVII, 14</cite> <he>וזימנת להם ז׳</he> and Thou didst provide &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 652">Yalk.
